name: kettlebell angled press
description: A kettlebell press at an angle between a front and a side raise path. It suits natural shoulder movement and builds pressing strength.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder and stand tall.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bell up and slightly out to the side in a diagonal path.
Lock out your arm without leaning back.
Lower under control, finish the reps, then switch arms.
